brief: Before and after adopting Claude Code as our primary dev tool — 6 honest metrics, 90 days in.

slots.title: Stop writing
slots.description: We switched to Claude Code for 90 days. Here are six honest metrics that changed how we build software.

slots.title: End setup
slots.description: Environment drift and dependency issues killed our momentum before a single line of code.
slots.badText: Engineers lost half a day configuring local containers and chasing version conflicts.
slots.goodText: One command loads context and dependencies automatically across every machine.

slots.title: Ship reviews
slots.description: Pull requests used to sit idle waiting for senior devs to find context.
slots.badText: Reviews sat in queues for days while context was hunted down manually.
slots.goodText: Claude summarizes diffs and suggests fixes before humans even open the tab.

slots.title: Stop shipping
slots.description: Production incidents peaked every sprint because edge cases were missed in manual checks.
slots.badText: Late-night pages woke the team after untested paths hit production servers.
slots.goodText: Proactive tests and inline reasoning catch edge cases before merge.

slots.title: Docs write
slots.description: Our wiki was a graveyard of stale screenshots and broken API references.
slots.badText: No one updated the readme, so new hires onboarded by word of mouth.
slots.goodText: Every PR now ships with auto-generated context and updated architecture notes.

slots.title: Onboard devs
slots.description: New engineers used to need two weeks to push their first meaningful commit.
slots.badText: Mentors repeated the same monologue about codebase history and tribal knowledge.
slots.goodText: Interactive codebase chat replaces hand-holding and surfaces patterns instantly.

slots.title: Reclaim deep work
slots.description: Context switching between Stack Overflow and terminal shattered our flow state daily.
slots.badText: Developers toggled between browsers, docs, and IDEs just to write one function.
slots.goodText: Everything happens in the IDE with instant answers and generated snippets.

slots.body: Join teams that replaced friction with flow. Try Claude Code free for 90 days and measure the difference.
